text.i: Vehicle Routing: Problems, Methods, and Applications.

page.text: : The Vehicle Routing Problem assigns a fleet of vehicles to customer locations such
that total distance/time is minimized subject to capacity, time-window, and driver-shift
constraints. NP-hard in general — practitioners use heuristics (savings algorithm, tabu
search, large neighborhood search). Solving VRP well at scale is worth single-digit
millions per year for any large logistics network.

text.i: Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA): Implementation Guide.

page.text: : As of 2024, every prescription drug in the US has unit-level serialization, end-to-
end electronic chain-of-custody (EPCIS), and verifiable transactions at every handoff.
The largest mandatory traceability rollout in commerce history. Operators outside
healthcare should study it; serialization is coming for food, electronics, and apparel.
